device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC compact satellite receiver
device.soc: ALi C3503D (chip word 0x3503D000, SDK chip code 0x10051)

source.author: Ferguson
source.note: Official archive A54_20190926_V1.3B1.zip from ferguson-digital.eu; fetched 2026-10-31.

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, chip word 0x3503D000 -> SDK chip code 0x10051): its boot-ROM bootloader at offset 0x800 runs in the boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800 ($sp = 0x9FE07F00), unpacks the 9.8 MB maincode into RAM and starts it at 0x80000200.  The internal S3501-class DVB-S2 demodulator answers at 0xB804C000 (without it NIM_S3505_0 fails with "ERROR: reset nim failed!!!" and keeps GMA layer 0 disabled) and the M3031 tuner answers at I2C 0x20.  Drives its external FD650K 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 24 (SCL) / 23 (SDA) through " On ", " on ", "nenu" and renders its 1280x720 "System Setup" OSD menu (92 unique colours) through GMA layer 0 at 0xB8006300.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 54 official firmware V1.3B1 (2019-09-26) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the single-CPU ALi C3503D SoC.

Unlike the dual-core C3505 Ariva 104 / 204 / 154 / 254 boxes, this image has no seecode chunk (single MIPS CPU running both UI and media/display drivers), maps its internal DVB-S2 demodulator at 0xB804C000 instead of 0xB8028000, and drives an external IR/4-digit FD650K sensor on GPIO 24 / 23.
